profile.facility_type_note: Part of Digital Realty's Chicago metro campus, spanning Elk Grove Village and Franklin Park near O'Hare (ORD airport code used in Digital Realty's naming). Confirmed addresses per Digital Realty's own site include ORD12 at 9333 Grand Avenue, ORD13 at 9355 Grand Avenue, and ORD14 at 9377 Grand Avenue, all Franklin Park, consistent with a clustered multi-building campus on the same street.

reading.body:
Digital Realty's ORD12 facility in Franklin Park holds 110,000 square feet of space with 2N UPS redundancy, but the operator has not published its IT load capacity. Without a megawatt figure from the operator's own site, the campus cannot be ranked against other facilities or translated into a meaningful rack or accelerator count for AI workloads.

Illinois has 44 mapped data centers, of which only 6 publish power capacity figures totaling 236 MW. ORD12 is not among the six published, meaning it does not appear in the state's disclosed capacity inventory. The facility is part of a multi-building cluster on Grand Avenue in Franklin Park near O'Hare Airport, alongside ORD13 and ORD14, but individual campus power figures remain unpublished.

For a reader assessing whether this campus matters to AI scaling, the absence of a published megawatt specification is definitive. Grid constraint analysis and capacity planning require known load; a facility of unknown power capacity cannot be evaluated against the binding constraints on AI compute deployment in its region.
